jobs.title: Senior PMO / Portfolio Program Manager – Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Compensation & Location

Location: Rosemead, CA — 2131 Walnut Grove Avenue

Schedule: Full-time, long-term contract

Work Type: Hybrid — onsite Tuesday & Wednesday, plus additional days as requested

Pay Range: $109.00 - $116.00 per hour

Benefits:
Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401k, Continuing & On-Demand Education

📍 Must be willing to work onsite in Rosemead, CA on Tuesdays and Wednesdays and as requested

‼️ W2 ONLY — No C2C, No 3rd Parties

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior PMO / Portfolio Program Manager
to provide portfolio-level governance and execution support for a large Digital Customer Experience technology portfolio
.

This role will own the integrated portfolio workplan, financial management, governance, risk and dependency management, executive reporting, vendor oversight, and change control
across multiple technology workstreams. The position requires someone who can operate strategically with senior leadership while remaining hands-on enough to build and maintain detailed plans, financial rollups, governance artifacts, and executive reporting.

The ideal candidate has strong experience establishing or operating a business and IT PMO
, managing complex multi-vendor technology transformations, and driving accountability across senior stakeholders without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Own and maintain the integrated portfolio workplan
across multiple technology workstreams.
Manage milestones, dependencies, critical paths, ownership, and stage-gate readiness.
Consolidate and manage baseline budgets, forecasts, actuals, contingency, and variance reporting
.
Reconcile Customer Service financial reporting with IT financial reporting.
Maintain integrated risks, issues, actions, decisions, dependencies, and changes (RAID)
.
Establish owners, due dates, escalation thresholds, aging, and closure expectations.
Prepare weekly and monthly portfolio-level executive reporting
.
Develop concise, decision-ready presentations and materials for senior leadership and governance forums.
Operate portfolio governance, intake, prioritization, and change-control processes
.
Manage additions, descopes, pauses, reprioritization, and other portfolio changes.
Coordinate vendor and contract oversight across Customer Service, IT, Finance, Procurement, and external delivery partners
.
Design and maintain the portfolio operating model, RACI, governance calendar, and escalation paths
.
Establish clear boundaries and coordination mechanisms with existing PMO organizations.
Support paired business and IT project leads while maintaining appropriate workstream ownership.
Drive decisions and closure across senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Create a sustainable PMO framework including templates, governance cadence, decision history, reporting standards, and handoff documentation
.

What This Person Will Be Working On

A large Digital Customer Experience technology portfolio
.
An integrated portfolio consisting of at least three significant technology workstreams
.
Business and IT portfolio governance.
Portfolio-level financial management and value tracking.
Executive reporting and decision governance.
Multi-vendor technology transformation.
Customer Service and IT financial reconciliation.
Portfolio risk, issue, dependency, and change management.
Hybrid Agile and stage-gated technology delivery.
PMO operating-model development and implementation.
Vendor and contract oversight.
Customer-service technology initiatives that may include Conversational AI, contact-center platforms, billing, collections, SAP, and related enterprise systems
.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor's degree
.
Demonstrated ownership of an integrated technology portfolio with at least three meaningful workstreams
.
Strong PMO, Program Management, and Portfolio Management
experience.
Experience operating across both business and IT organizations
.
Strong portfolio financial-management experience, including:
Budget management
Forecasting
Actuals
Financial reconciliation
Contingency management
Variance analysis
Value tracking
Strong RAID and change-control management
experience.
Experience managing complex dependencies and critical paths across multiple technology initiatives.
Strong executive communication and presentation capabilities.
Ability to translate complex portfolio information into clear decisions, consequences, risks, and next steps
.
Experience with multi-vendor technology transformation programs
.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountability without direct authority
.
Experience operating within hybrid Agile and stage-gated governance models
.
Ability to balance strategic portfolio leadership with detailed, hands-on PMO execution.
Ability to provide credible examples or sanitized work samples of integrated plans, executive reporting, financial rollups, or decision-governance artifacts.

Desired Skills

Utility or regulated-industry experience.
Digital Customer Experience / Customer Service technology experience.
Conversational AI
experience.
Contact-center technology experience.
Billing and collections systems experience.
SAP experience.
Experience establishing or mobilizing a new PMO
.
Experience developing sustainable PMO operating models and governance frameworks.
Enterprise portfolio-management tools experience.
Executive governance and steering-committee experience.
Strong RACI and operating-model development experience.
Vendor and contract-management experience.
Experience working across IT, Finance, Procurement, Customer Service, and external vendors
.

jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator RN - Home Care- Iselin, NJ- FT
jobs.description:
Description

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

At Hackensack Meridian Health at Home, we recognize our full- and part-time benefit eligible team members by offering a Total Rewards package including comprehensive Health Benefits, generous Paid Time Off, Travel Reimbursement as well as an investment in your future with a 401(k) match and Tuition Reimbursement. Per Diem team members are eligible to participate in Travel Reimbursement and may be eligible to receive a 401(k) match. At www.TeamHMH.com, you’ll find the information, resources and tools that will help you to be successful at HMH. From great benefits and innovative wellness programs, to robust learning and development opportunities, we continue to cultivate an exceptional work environment where you can do the kind of work that leads to fulfillment and professional growth.

Responsibilties

Responsible for assisting the clinical operation by providing telephonic case management as well as quality, patient satisfaction and process flow initiatives and reports to the Manager of Clinical Practice.

Collaborates with specialists, other physicians, and professionals at local healthcare facilities and in the community, to provide home health services to patients in need of skilled nursing care. Coordinates care by ensuring effective communication and completion of treatments/procedures.
Utilizes the nursing process (assessing, planning & implementing care) to provide nursing visits &/or manage a nursing case manager caseload, as needed. Provides comprehensive care and teaching to patients and families regarding the individualized plan of care. Applies clinical knowledge and skills (i.e., administration of medications, treatments, procedures, etc.) to safely provide direct patient care in a professional, caring, culturally- sensitive, and cost efficient manner; ensuring appropriate clinical coordination and support of patients and families.
Assist client care coordinators in prioritizing patients in scheduling visits for case managers, through clinical chart/ documentation review and triage, ensuring timely starts of care.
Functions as the patient advocate in coordinating patient care; including performing crisis intervention when required. Collaborates and confers with community agencies to identify resources that meet the patient's needs. Refers patients to community resources, as needed.
Attends patient care conferences and staff meetings as needed. Communicates the patient's special needs to appropriate team members.
Documents assessment and reassessment data, patient care activities, interventions, patient's responses, patient and family education, and discharge plans according to the plans of care, policies and procedures, etc., within predetermined timeframes.
Identifies outcomes and patient's response to treatments and procedures to include the effectiveness of interventions and initiatives (to include pain management). Reports all significant or unexpected outcomes of interventions to the patient's physician.
Identifies learning needs. Recognizes appropriate educational content and methodologies required to meet the patient's and/or family member's specific educational needs. Identifies learning readiness. Initiates learning activities.
Delegates patient-specific tasks and activities to ancillary personnel based on competencies, regulatory, agency, and program-specific policies, procedures, and guidelines as required. Collaborates with support staff regarding delegated tasks &/or activity to ascertain if care was provided according to the care plan.
Serves as a resource to the nursing staff, physicians, and other health care team members related to home care. Mentors current and new staff, when needed; participating in educational programs and workstreams.
Run and review productivity, and clinical reports as well as conduct periodic audits of patient records for QAPI.
Evaluates patient care practice in relation to individual team/patient satisfaction targets, and follow-up as needed.
Work in EMR to review admissions and discharges, ensuring appropriate clinical documentation and OASIS accuracy if needed.
Maintains personal growth and development by attending educational programs and workshops. Reviews current literature to maintain competencies and expertise in clinical practice.
Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.
Lifts a minimum of 50 lbs, pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs and stands a minimum of 4 hours a day.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

Associate's Degree in Nursing or Diploma Certificate in Nursing.
Minimum of two (2) or more years RN Experience.
Minimum of three (3) years certified home care experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Google Suite and/or Microsoft Office platforms.

Education, Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Preferred

OASIS certified.
BSN.

Licenses And Certifications Required

NJ State Professional Registered Nurse License.
BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification.

HMH is committed to pay equity and transparency for our team members. The posted rate of pay in this job posting is a reasonable good faith estimate of the minimum base pay for this role at the time of posting in accordance with the New Jersey Pay Transparency Act and does not reflect the full value of our market-competitive total rewards package.

Job Duties

The starting rate of pay is provided for informational purposes only and is not a guarantee of a specific offer. Posted hourly rates may be stated as an annual salary in the offer and posted annual salaries may be stated as an hourly rate in the offer, depending on the level and nature of the job duties and credentials of the candidate. The base compensation determined at the time of the offer may be different than the posted rate of pay based on a number of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to:

Labor Market Data: Compensation is benchmarked against market data to ensure competitiveness.
Experience: Years of relevant work experience.
Education and Certifications: Level of education attained, including specialized certifications, credentials, completed apprenticeship programs or advanced training.
Skills: Demonstrated proficiency in relevant skills and competencies.
Geographic Location: Cost of living and market rates for the specific location.
Internal Equity: Compensation is determined in a manner consistent with compensation ranges for similar roles within the organization.
Budget and Grant Funding: Departmental budgets and any grant funding associated with the job position may impact the pay that can be offered.

Some jobs may also be eligible for performance-based incentives, bonuses, or commissions not reflected in the starting rate. Certain positions may also be eligible for shift differentials for work performed on evening, night, or weekend shifts.

In addition to our compensation for full-time and part-time (20+ hours/week) job positions, HMH offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and retirement benefits.Minimum rate of $92,144.00 Annually

jobs.title: Safety Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Bengal is seeking an experienced Safety Compliance & Training Coordinator
to support employee onboarding, training, credential management, and workforce compliance.

This position works closely with Safety, Recruiting, Operations, Payroll, employees, and outside providers to ensure employees are properly screened, trained, documented, and cleared for work.

Hands-on experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA is required.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain employee records, eligibility, and rosters within Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Schedule and coordinate required training, including Safety Council, MSHA, OSHA 10/30, Security Passport, NCCER, NCCCO, and site-specific orientations.
Maintain employee certifications, assessments, and training records in FCC.
Run monthly FCC reports to identify upcoming expirations and coordinate required renewals or recertifications.
Assist with onsite new-hire onboarding and ensure required documentation is completed.
Create and maintain employee electronic files in SharePoint, including I-9 documentation, direct deposit forms, training cards, credentials, and certifications.
Submit background checks, run MVRs, coordinate drug screens, and track outstanding employee clearance requirements.
Coordinate weekly Cintas uniform service, including orders, exchanges, replacements, and returns.
Maintain safety-related spreadsheets, reports, rosters, and compliance records.
Communicate with employees, supervisors, training providers, and internal departments regarding missing or expiring requirements.

Required Qualifications

Experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Experience scheduling industrial safety training and maintaining employee compliance records.
Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple employees, deadlines, and expiration dates simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

FCC or similar training/compliance management system.
Microsoft SharePoint.
Familiarity with TWIC, NCCER, NCCCO, OSHA, MSHA, Security Passport, and industrial site-access requirements.

Position Details

Full-Time | Permanent | Monday-Friday | Onsite | Safety Department

jobs.title: Clinical Research Assistant II (Contract) - On Call - 6-8 weeks
jobs.description:
We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Job Description

Performs daily clinic tasks to assist coordinators with study procedures. Tasks may include but are not limited to Electronic Self-Assessment Questionnaire (ESAQ) administrations, check-in process, informed consent signing, instrumentation assist, photography assist, etc.

Performs daily administrative tasks to assist coordinators in study preparation and conduct. Tasks may include but are not limited to test material preparation, making appointment reminders, quality checking (QC) study documents, etc.

May assists in the development of study paperwork for coordinators

Report to clinic on-time for all studies assigned to work

Perform tasks according to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, applicable regulations, standard operation procedures (SOP), and work instructions

May perform tasks for other departments, as needed

Provides excellent customer service to clients and panelists, and maintains positive and respectful interaction with peers and leadership

Complies with and understands safety and Operational Integrity procedures and processes.

Qualifications

Associates degree or at least one year of administrative/clerical work experience
CCRC/CCRA certification a strong plus
Strong attention to detail and organizational, verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills
Able to follow instructions and study protocols according to GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs
Able to lift moderately heavy items.
Ability to manage and coordinate multiple projects in a fast-paced, highly professional environment.
Must be flexible to work morning/afternoon shifts.

Additional Information

new_jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator RN - Home Care- Iselin, NJ- FT
new_jobs.description:
Description

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

At Hackensack Meridian Health at Home, we recognize our full- and part-time benefit eligible team members by offering a Total Rewards package including comprehensive Health Benefits, generous Paid Time Off, Travel Reimbursement as well as an investment in your future with a 401(k) match and Tuition Reimbursement. Per Diem team members are eligible to participate in Travel Reimbursement and may be eligible to receive a 401(k) match. At www.TeamHMH.com, you’ll find the information, resources and tools that will help you to be successful at HMH. From great benefits and innovative wellness programs, to robust learning and development opportunities, we continue to cultivate an exceptional work environment where you can do the kind of work that leads to fulfillment and professional growth.

Responsibilties

Responsible for assisting the clinical operation by providing telephonic case management as well as quality, patient satisfaction and process flow initiatives and reports to the Manager of Clinical Practice.

Collaborates with specialists, other physicians, and professionals at local healthcare facilities and in the community, to provide home health services to patients in need of skilled nursing care. Coordinates care by ensuring effective communication and completion of treatments/procedures.
Utilizes the nursing process (assessing, planning & implementing care) to provide nursing visits &/or manage a nursing case manager caseload, as needed. Provides comprehensive care and teaching to patients and families regarding the individualized plan of care. Applies clinical knowledge and skills (i.e., administration of medications, treatments, procedures, etc.) to safely provide direct patient care in a professional, caring, culturally- sensitive, and cost efficient manner; ensuring appropriate clinical coordination and support of patients and families.
Assist client care coordinators in prioritizing patients in scheduling visits for case managers, through clinical chart/ documentation review and triage, ensuring timely starts of care.
Functions as the patient advocate in coordinating patient care; including performing crisis intervention when required. Collaborates and confers with community agencies to identify resources that meet the patient's needs. Refers patients to community resources, as needed.
Attends patient care conferences and staff meetings as needed. Communicates the patient's special needs to appropriate team members.
Documents assessment and reassessment data, patient care activities, interventions, patient's responses, patient and family education, and discharge plans according to the plans of care, policies and procedures, etc., within predetermined timeframes.
Identifies outcomes and patient's response to treatments and procedures to include the effectiveness of interventions and initiatives (to include pain management). Reports all significant or unexpected outcomes of interventions to the patient's physician.
Identifies learning needs. Recognizes appropriate educational content and methodologies required to meet the patient's and/or family member's specific educational needs. Identifies learning readiness. Initiates learning activities.
Delegates patient-specific tasks and activities to ancillary personnel based on competencies, regulatory, agency, and program-specific policies, procedures, and guidelines as required. Collaborates with support staff regarding delegated tasks &/or activity to ascertain if care was provided according to the care plan.
Serves as a resource to the nursing staff, physicians, and other health care team members related to home care. Mentors current and new staff, when needed; participating in educational programs and workstreams.
Run and review productivity, and clinical reports as well as conduct periodic audits of patient records for QAPI.
Evaluates patient care practice in relation to individual team/patient satisfaction targets, and follow-up as needed.
Work in EMR to review admissions and discharges, ensuring appropriate clinical documentation and OASIS accuracy if needed.
Maintains personal growth and development by attending educational programs and workshops. Reviews current literature to maintain competencies and expertise in clinical practice.
Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.
Lifts a minimum of 50 lbs, pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs and stands a minimum of 4 hours a day.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

Associate's Degree in Nursing or Diploma Certificate in Nursing.
Minimum of two (2) or more years RN Experience.
Minimum of three (3) years certified home care experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Google Suite and/or Microsoft Office platforms.

Education, Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Preferred

OASIS certified.
BSN.

Licenses And Certifications Required

NJ State Professional Registered Nurse License.
BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification.

HMH is committed to pay equity and transparency for our team members. The posted rate of pay in this job posting is a reasonable good faith estimate of the minimum base pay for this role at the time of posting in accordance with the New Jersey Pay Transparency Act and does not reflect the full value of our market-competitive total rewards package.

Posted hourly rates may be stated as an annual salary in the offer and posted annual salaries may be stated as an hourly rate in the offer, depending on the level and nature of the job duties and credentials of the candidate. new_jobs.title: Safety Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

Bengal is seeking an experienced Safety Compliance & Training Coordinator
to support employee onboarding, training, credential management, and workforce compliance.

This position works closely with Safety, Recruiting, Operations, Payroll, employees, and outside providers to ensure employees are properly screened, trained, documented, and cleared for work.

Hands-on experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA is required.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain employee records, eligibility, and rosters within Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Schedule and coordinate required training, including Safety Council, MSHA, OSHA 10/30, Security Passport, NCCER, NCCCO, and site-specific orientations.
Maintain employee certifications, assessments, and training records in FCC.
Run monthly FCC reports to identify upcoming expirations and coordinate required renewals or recertifications.
Assist with onsite new-hire onboarding and ensure required documentation is completed.
Create and maintain employee electronic files in SharePoint, including I-9 documentation, direct deposit forms, training cards, credentials, and certifications.
Submit background checks, run MVRs, coordinate drug screens, and track outstanding employee clearance requirements.
Coordinate weekly Cintas uniform service, including orders, exchanges, replacements, and returns.
Maintain safety-related spreadsheets, reports, rosters, and compliance records.
Communicate with employees, supervisors, training providers, and internal departments regarding missing or expiring requirements.

Required Qualifications

Experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Experience scheduling industrial safety training and maintaining employee compliance records.
Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple employees, deadlines, and expiration dates simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

FCC or similar training/compliance management system.
Microsoft SharePoint.
Familiarity with TWIC, NCCER, NCCCO, OSHA, MSHA, Security Passport, and industrial site-access requirements.

Position Details

Full-Time | Permanent | Monday-Friday | Onsite | Safety Department
